properties.sql:
SELECT p.*
FROM app_fd_pmt p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM app_fd_dossier_commission
    WHERE c_id_commission = '#requestParam.id_commission#'
      AND c_id_dossier = p.id
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM app_fd_dossier_commission
    WHERE c_id_dossier = p.id
      AND (c_issaved = 'true' or c_issaved = 'done')
)
AND 
p.c_statut_enquete = 'A valider'
ORDER BY p.dateCreated ASC
